Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Cost: about $0.25 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $100 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.

Every two weeks, check the position still qualifies and that a liquidity position can lose value when prices move apart, so check the pair before you deposit. Cost: nothing to check. Time: 5 minutes every two weeks.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes; rewards are unconfirmed and no one should ever pay to claim. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Unwind in two tranches a week apart, and write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position. Cost: about $0.50 of gas to unwind. Time: 10 minutes.
